accessibility.name: Web accessibility
accessibility.description: Build and test interfaces for keyboard navigation and assistive technologies.

web-performance.name: Web performance
web-performance.description: Measure and improve page loading, rendering, and interaction performance.

design-systems.name: Accessible component libraries
design-systems.description: Build reusable UI components with documented states, platform accessibility semantics, input behavior, and shared visual tokens for web or native applications.

browser-devtools.name: Browser network and rendering diagnostics
browser-devtools.description: Inspect request waterfalls, runtime exceptions, layout shifts, and rendering profiles to reproduce and diagnose interface failures.

forms-validation.name: Form handling and validation
forms-validation.description: Validate user input and present accessible errors without losing form state.

browser-compatibility.name: Cross-browser compatibility testing
browser-compatibility.description: Verify critical interactions and layouts across supported browsers, devices, and input methods, and reproduce browser-specific regressions.

frontend-routing.name: Client-side routing
frontend-routing.description: Manage navigation, route parameters, deep links, and protected application views.

browser-authentication.name: Browser authentication flows
browser-authentication.description: Integrate sign-in and session renewal without exposing tokens or relying on client-only authorization.

frontend-test-automation.name: Frontend test automation
frontend-test-automation.description: Test components and complete user journeys with appropriate browser and interaction checks.

internationalization.name: Internationalization and localization
internationalization.description: Support translated content, locale-specific formatting, and adaptable interface layouts.

client-data-caching.name: Client-side data caching
client-data-caching.description: Manage request deduplication, cache invalidation, stale data, and optimistic updates.

frontend-security.name: Frontend security
frontend-security.description: Prevent script injection and unsafe cross-origin behavior through safe rendering and browser security controls.

server-rendering.name: Server rendering and hydration
server-rendering.description: Choose rendering strategies and handle hydration, caching, and client-server boundaries.

design-tokens.name: Design tokens and theming
design-tokens.description: Represent shared visual decisions as reusable tokens for consistent themes and components.

frontend-observability.name: Browser error and performance telemetry
frontend-observability.description: Capture browser exceptions, release identifiers, and user-facing timing measurements with privacy controls and actionable diagnostic context.

frontend-architecture.name: Frontend module and dependency boundaries
frontend-architecture.description: Separate route, feature, and shared-component modules with explicit interfaces and checks against circular or unintended dependencies.

visual-regression-testing.name: Visual regression testing
visual-regression-testing.description: Detect unintended interface changes using stable visual baselines and focused review.

frontend-release-strategies.name: Frontend release strategies
frontend-release-strategies.description: Roll out interface changes safely using feature flags, versioned assets, and rollback plans.
